tasks.task: Write a Python function that takes an S3 bucket name and returns the number of objects in the bucket using boto3, handling pagination.
Write a JSON IAM policy document that allows read-only access (s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket) to the bucket 'analytics-logs' and nothing else.
Write a regular expression that matches valid AWS EC2 instance IDs, which start with 'i-' followed by either 8 or 17 hexadecimal characters.
